name: i18n_frontend
title: Frontend translation
summary: Translates default-language pages in the browser from the translated data files (languages set to "frontend").
description: Only rendered by page_constructor when a language in data_settings_languages.json has "mode": "frontend", and only in dist output. Prints window.dmI18n (languages, the path to src/content/json/data/, the list of data files that exist in each frontend language, a version from their modification times) and the inline loader (assets/js/i18n_frontend_init.js) in <head>: it reads ?lang= or the saved choice (localStorage dm_lang), adds html.i18n-loading and fetches every listed data file in the default language and in the target language (data/en/<file> + data/<lang>/<file>). Both are walked in parallel (lists of entries matched by _id) and every text that differs becomes an English -> translation pair; values with HTML or line breaks are split at tags / line breaks and paired piece by piece when both sides have the same number of pieces. assets/js/i18n_frontend.js replaces text nodes and the tracked attributes (alt, title, placeholder, aria-label, data-label*, meta description / og / twitter, button values) whose whitespace-normalised text matches an English value, keeps the originals so switching back is instant, translates nodes added later (MutationObserver), sets <html lang>, updates the language dropdown and fires dm:i18n-start / dm:i18n-done for the preloader. Text the site builds itself (dates, counts, joined labels) has no data value to match and stays in the default language. Elements with translate="no", data-i18n-skip or .notranslate are left alone. Nothing is generated in dist/.
